v2-1768232318899-klg4t2w0b.name: Xylos
v2-1768232318899-klg4t2w0b.description: A vibrant, surreal alien landscape bathed in bright daylight under a clear, deep blue sky with a distant pink-orange celestial body. The terrain is an orange-brown sandy expanse dotted with patches of green vegetation. Structures feature red-rimmed oval windows and are primarily constructed with earthy tones, white, red, yellow, blue, and green. A lone figure with light blonde hair, wearing a light-colored dress, surveys the scene.

v2-1768232320841-ocrwjlwhq.name: Xylos's Magnificent Structure
v2-1768232320841-ocrwjlwhq.description: A magnificent, multi-layered structure on Xylos, resembling a whimsical, futuristic building or spacecraft. Its white oval main body is adorned with diamond-shaped windows of red, yellow, blue, and green, topped with slender yellow and red spires. Smaller, bulbous pods and platforms with colorful windows extend from its sides. The underside is a complex, organic mass of colorful elements. Elongated, pendulum-like ornaments and banners dangle from the structure. A graceful, curving white staircase with glowing yellow details descends from the lower part of the main structure towards the ground. A small, delicate character with short, light blonde hair, wearing a frilly, light-colored dress with a full skirt and short sleeves, stands at the base, holding a large cluster of bright yellow flowers or objects, her bare legs extending into white knee-high coverings. The weather is clear at midday.
